description: The current state of a Vuelo booking started with book_trip. Pass wait_seconds (up to 50) straight after the traveller has the link: it answers the moment they open it, pay or cancel, so you can tell them it is booked without being told.

wait_seconds.description: Hold the answer until the booking changes, up to this many seconds.
